The history of ACMUN.

ACMUN is the Model United Nations conference of Aitchison College, planned and run by the students of the society. Delegates represent countries, argue their positions, build alliances and write resolutions, guided by chairs who run every session.

A clear conference culture

Terms & conditions.

The shared expectations that help ACMUN remain thoughtful, fair and welcoming.

Participation

By registering for or attending ACMUN, participants agree to follow the conference schedule, instructions from the Secretariat and the Code of Conduct.

Respect and conduct

Delegates, chairs, staff and visitors are expected to treat one another with respect. Harassment, discrimination, intimidation and disruptive behavior are not accepted.

Photography and media

Conference photography or video may be used for ACMUN communications. Tell the Secretariat in advance if you have a specific concern about appearing in official coverage.

Programme changes

The Secretariat may adjust agendas, rooms, timings or committee assignments when necessary. Material changes will be communicated as soon as reasonably possible.

Questions

If you have a question about these terms, contact the ACMUN Secretariat through the Suggestions page before the conference.

Suggestions.

Tell the ACMUN team what we should keep, change or add.

Code of conduct.

Every delegate, chair and guest agrees to these rules for the whole conference.

Respect everyone

Treat delegates, chairs, staff and guests with courtesy. Disagree with ideas, never with people.

Follow diplomatic decorum

Address the chair and other delegates formally and speak only when recognised.

Dress formally

Wear formal attire to every session.

Keep your work original

Write your own research and position papers. Plagiarism leads to disqualification from awards.

Use devices responsibly

Use phones and laptops only for committee work during sessions.

No harassment or discrimination

Bullying, hate speech and harassment of any kind are not tolerated.

Follow the rules of the venue

Follow all Aitchison College rules and the instructions of the organising team.

Accept the consequences

Breaking these rules can lead to a warning, removal from a committee or removal from the conference.
